scope: Exact historical subset mapping, not application execution or acceptance of original AT/EX

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: Injected fixture identities and single-owner grants only. No real authentication, multiple-subject consent lattice, private index side-channel proof or joint-source policy tests.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Construct joint A+B source requiring both grants; deny after either revision changes; distinguish owner/subject/audience; no existence leakage.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: Digest comparison detects changed source at read but no correction/CAS/delete/tombstone API, summary/embedding lineage, queued publication or restore replay. Reopening one DB is not restoring a stale backup. Rejected/revoked raw attempt output remains in coordinator.py63-66; README documents retained synthetic audit history. Withholding is not erasure.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Add source revision+dependency invalidation transaction and stale-snapshot/tombstone merge-before-serve case; distinguish retention receipt from actual third-party deletion.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: No evidence returns unavailable without backend; no domain readiness snapshot, calibration expiry/UNKNOWN capture or receipt service. CURRENT_STATE label alone is not freshness evaluation.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Use injected clock and synthetic readiness profile; expired calibration remains unavailable with inference down; preserve independent reminders/recovery.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: Empty allowlists and absent adapters are inert baseline, not tested multi-route router or OS isolation. Byte caps not token/media accounting.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Eligibility precedes cost; forbidden provider cannot receive any bytes; missing evidence cannot trigger stronger model; manifest deterministic omissions; actual adapter tokenization test after approval.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: Zero-spend guard and two-attempt cap only; no monetary reservation, invoice, parent-child budget or crash recovery ledger.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Race two admissions against shared allowance; mark admitted before dispatch; timeout/restart/expiry retains exposure; duplicate settlement applies once; rate mismatch stops admission.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: No cancel API/epoch/lease or independently supervised parent-death stop. No external writes, so no actual digital/physical reconciliation. Manual RUNNING mutation not crash experiment. Child.start/send.close precede the cleanup try; startup/pipe failure needs coverage. read79-101 then cli52-56/render4-31 has a delayed-release window not exercised by the fresh-read test.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Actual coordinator-kill and stale worker tests under independent supervisor; publication suppression and compute stop separately observed; unknown effects never replay; mocked broker reconciliation only.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: No scheduler, resource lease, occupied-service-time ledger or concurrency fairness tests.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Deterministic two-user queue with controlled worker durations; one accelerator holder; bounded background quantum; no starvation; cancellation/control-plane independent of accelerator.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: Fixture injection/tool guards are real narrower tests; no Hermes/OpenClaw run or audit of background memory/review/scheduler/plugin calls.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Keep framework absent first; if later approved, exact config/tool digest and every auxiliary call counted, memory/skills/shell/browser/scheduler/delegation disabled and verified.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: Text fixture IDs/hash/category/render tests only; no image decoding, vision input, OCR, capture freshness or temporal frames. Exact quote equality not entailment.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Use licensed/synthetic selected images with region labels and UNKNOWN timestamps; trace original/crop hash; semantic relevance and wrong-object/occlusion/injection cases; no unseen-scene claim.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: No audio fixtures, ASR/TTS, playback, recipient resolution, diarization or stop channels.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Separate stop playback/reasoning/schedule/domain recovery; ambiguous names/numbers/recipient requires clarification; authenticated device, never voice authentication; private-output audience recheck.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: ModelBackend protocol+fixture name/version only; no real provider protocol, normalized billing, refusals/media schemas or drift evaluation.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Freeze actual model/runtime/tokenizer/template/preprocessing/tool/dataset versions; unsupported feature fails closed; test aliases/usage categories/refusals/cancel and exact-schema support per route.

r02_cases.precise_remaining_gap: Five-candidate arithmetic and promotion denial evidenced; same writer authored evaluator; no physical measurements, independent metrology, held-out physical conditions or simultaneous household operation.
r02_cases.proposed_acceptance: Retain fixed scores and rejected candidates; separate independent evaluator/dataset owner; simulation/replay first; later individually authorized measurements and fabrication; no safety claim.
